definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of 原子力発電所. Refers to facilities that generate electricity using nuclear fission.

examples.japanese: {原発|げんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再稼働|さいかどう}→再稼働：29736_saikadou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{原発|げんぱつ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: News of a nuclear plant accident was broadcast.

examples.japanese: {原発|げんぱつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: Opinions are divided on whether to support or oppose nuclear power plants.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原発|げんぱつ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (nuclear power plant accident)
- {原発|げんぱつ}⟦{再稼働|さいかどう}→再稼働：29736_saikadou⟧ (restart of a nuclear plant)
- {原発|げんぱつ}⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ (opposition to nuclear power)
- {原発|げんぱつ}⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧ (zero nuclear power)

FORMS:
Abbreviation of {原子力発電所|げんしりょくはつでんしょ} (nuclear power generation station). After the 2011 {福島|ふくしま}⟦{第一|だいいち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧{原発|げんぱつ}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧, this word became central to public discourse in Japan. The debate over {脱原発|だつげんぱつ} (phasing out nuclear power) versus {原発|げんぱつ}⟦{再稼働|さいかどう}→再稼働：29736_saikadou⟧ (restarting plants) remains a major political topic.
